runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-pip && printf '[global]\nbreak-system-packages = true\n' > /etc/pip.conf && python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'flit_core>=3.12,<4' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
runner.env_probe_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import tomlparse, os; assert os.path.realpath(tomlparse.__file__).startswith(os.path.realpath('src')); d = tomlparse.loads('[player]\nname = \"probe\"\nnumber = 1'); assert d == {'player': {'name': 'probe', 'number': 1}}"

init_metadata.tech_stack: Pure Python TOML parser (flit_core src layout, zero runtime deps, stdlib unittest); CPU-only

hardware_requirements.summary: This is a pure-Python library that parses TOML documents into native mappings, sequences, and scalars. The default path has no compiled extensions, no runtime third-party dependencies, and no GPU or accelerator requirements. The documented interpreter floor is Python 3.8 or newer. Any standard x86_64 or arm64 Linux, macOS, or Windows host with a supported interpreter is sufficient to install from source and run the test suite. Optional compiled wheels exist for performance on some platforms; they are not required for the mandatory CPU profile.

profiles.label: CPU baseline
profiles.description: Standard CPU-only Python execution path. Core capability is parsing a TOML document from this repository's source tree into native Python dict, list, and scalar values.
probes: cd /opt/codingbench/repo && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import tomlparse, os; assert os.path.realpath(tomlparse.__file__).startswith(os.path.realpath('src')); assert tomlparse.loads('k = 1') == {'k': 1}"
profiles.setup_notes: pyproject.toml requires-python >=3.8 and declares zero runtime dependencies. CI installs with pip install . then runs python -m unittest on ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, and windows-latest across CPython 3.8-3.15-dev and PyPy 3.11. tox env_list is 3.8-3.14 with the same unittest command. Optional TOMLPARSE_USE_MYPYC=1 plus scripts/use_setuptools.py (setuptools>=77.0.3, mypy[mypyc]>=1.15) builds binary wheels; not required for the default path. Fuzzer extra documents apt install clang. No system libraries beyond a normal Python toolchain.
profiles.build_notes: No compiled/native build step for the default path. Packaging uses flit_core>=3.12,<4 (pyproject.toml [build-system]); the importable package lives under the src layout. Editable install: pip install -e . CI uses pip install . then python -m unittest. Pure-Python artifacts are produced with python -m build.
